claims.family: for each of the five predictions G (MnvTune v1 = the analysis MC; GENIE 2.12.10 CV, GENIE 2.12.10 + Valencia MEC and NuWro 21.09, flux-repaired, KNOWN_ISSUES 83; GiBUU 2019 in the analysis flux convention, KNOWN_ISSUES 82): H0(G) 'the true cross sections of the 109 supported J cells (GiBUU: the 36 cells with p_parallel < 6 GeV/c) equal G's'; two tests each (total, shape-only): 10 tests
claims.rejection: H0(G) is rejected at familywise 0.05 only by s5p_inference.holm_determined on the CLAIM p-values (the largest p over the process-shift variants): a step rejects only when the 95% Clopper-Pearson interval of k/B lies entirely below its Holm threshold; an interval containing it stops the procedure with 'undetermined' (no claim either way at that level)
claims.non_rejection: reported with the power of the same test against P1r-P3r at the NULL IT BELONGS TO (MnvTune null: a = 1, 200 each; GENIE CV null: a = 1, 100 each), at 0.05 and at the Holm first-step level 0.005, under the claim rule with the determinacy rule (s5p_inference.power_determined); low power is a limitation, never agreement
conditions_stated_with_every_claim: the null truth is G at the fine 5D grid (fine-ratio null, J integrals exactly G's). Below the fine grid the null truth carries MnvTune's shapes and G's finite-MC fine-cell fluctuations, and this residual is UNMEASURED AND POTENTIALLY MATERIAL: the fine-vs-merged-x2 check (M1) moved the J cells by 0.50-0.86 of the coarse-to-fine step (median |fine - merged|/f 0.32-1.10%), i.e. not converged (state/s5p/stage3/m1/); its size in null-T units is reported with the result

the MC detector simulation per event beyond the drawn detector bands (MinosEfficiency, GEANT neutron/pion/proton, each +-1 sigma) and the linear lateral surrogate (five bands); there is no recoil-energy-scale band in the analysis's systematic set (app_statmethods.tex), so hadronic-response completeness is not established

the interaction-model prior is the analysis's vertical band set (34 bands, every band drawn per experiment); negative weights of LowQ2_1/HighQ2_1 are clipped per universe (EXCEPTION-20260927-s5p-pilot-negative-rate-resubmission.md: <= 0.35% of a band's shift in whitened norm)

the pseudo-experiment process unfolds with half the MC, the data with all of it; the MC-size shift D is at noise level at all five nulls (16 pairs: median |D|/f 0.02-0.075%) and enters as the bias-aligned upper-bound variant

GiBUU: E_nu > 20 GeV absent (KNOWN_ISSUES 82) and its out-of-domain truth (p_parallel >= 6 GeV/c, E_nu-truncated) enters the migrations into the domain cells; all generators: E_nu > 100 GeV absent (only the data's flux integral stops there; negligible)
the predictions' own finite MC enters as diag Var(mu_G) in the metric and as a drawn residual term

calibration.process: s5p_nullexp.py at the null truth (fine-ratio null; MnvTune: rho = 1): per experiment fresh Poisson pseudo-data from MC half B and background source C, refinement refit, R (5 iterations) on MC half A; nuisance draws on the pseudo-data source: one PPFX flux universe (of 100); EVERY interaction-model band at one of its universes (34 bands), coherently for the background source and the signal response with fine-cell truth preservation; the four weight-only detector bands (dump; MinosEfficiency's 18 reco-failing NaN rows set to 1 and counted, non-finite values refused where used); downstream: lateral z_b Delta_b (Delta from the ten real-data endpoint unfolds, runs/s3/latunf), normalization 1.4% z, the data's rounding noise (20 real-data jitters), the prediction's finite-MC residual (drawn per experiment, keyed by seed)
calibration.sequential_rule: batches of 200 seeds in fixed order per null, at most 1999; before each batch s5p_seqstop.py evaluates both claim p-values on the finished products (partials excluded) and stops the null when s5p_inference.sequential_decision stops both (99.5% Clopper-Pearson look interval: no decision threshold straddled, T7 precision at the point estimate, or an upper end below every threshold); a meter cap refusal writes a 'budget' final status, the last line a 'batches exhausted' one; the p-value stays valid at the B reached (the determinacy rule decides claims)
calibration.seeds: calibration 1200000 + 20000 i (i = 0 MnvTune, 1 GENIE CV, 2 GENIE MEC, 3 NuWro, 4 GiBUU); power MnvTune null 1451000/1461000/1471000 (a = 1), GENIE CV null 1481000/1491000/1501000; the generator refuses overlapping ranges
calibration.metric: W = V + diag Var(mu_G); V = the standardized Ledoit-Wolf covariance (s5p_joint build-v) of the 200-experiment all-band design pilot s3v (MnvTune null, GEANT detector bands from the bank, MinosEfficiency absent; seeds 965000-965199); V sets power only; its sha256 is recorded here at the freeze
calibration.process_shift: D16-<null>.npz (state/s5p/stage3/f4/, digests in the design), mode bias_aligned_upper, variants c in (0, 1/2, 1)

validation_and_assurance.validation_operand: the calibration ensemble of each null itself, through (i) rank exactness within the pseudo process (any B), (ii) the determinacy rule for decisions, (iii) the process-shift variants and the implied size they report, (iv) the observed p's stability over the 20 real-data rounding jitters (reported per test), and (v) an independent re-computation of every p-value and decision from the products by a reviewer's own code before the joint result is recorded
validation_and_assurance.size_clause: T6's size clause is a report without a failing outcome (amendment 8): validity rests on (i)-(iii)

power: P1r (W3), P2r (D5), P3r (W2) rebuilt from the repaired predictions: at the MnvTune null a = 1 (200 each) and at the GENIE CV null a = 1 (100 each); the a = 0.5 sets of the earlier draft are dropped for cost; T6 power >= 0.80 at 0.005 under the claim and determinacy rules for the shape test at a = 1 at the MnvTune null is the target; the design pilot's development power (P1r-P3r, 50 each, all-band) is recorded here at the freeze
